body.text: Un archivo de instrucciones que le enseña a Claude tu proceso, tu cliente y tu sistema. No responde genérico: responde desde adentro de tu operación.

body.text: Convierte un topic en un brief JSON completo: narrativa, paleta, personaje y prompts visuales por slide. Carrusel listo en minutos, no en horas.

images.concept: Dark editorial product shot. A matte black widescreen monitor angled slightly toward camera sits on a dark desk surface. The screen displays a Claude Code agent interface: on the left panel a PNG thumbnail of a dark editorial carousel slide is visible, on the right panel a structured layout plan JSON with gold highlighted keys like textColor, position, safeZone, shadow, glow. Thin golden ruler/grid lines overlay the thumbnail showing safe zones and alignment guides. Beside the monitor: a minimal notebook and a gold metallic pen. Behind the monitor: subtle soft focused deep black texture with a warm directional rim light from camera-left creating a golden glow on the monitor edge. Top 40% clear dark space for headline. No text in image except the faint UI on screen. 4:5 vertical.

body.text: Analiza cada PNG con visión computacional y decide color, posición, sombra y glow del texto slide por slide. Layout consciente de la imagen, no plantilla ciega.

A thin golden line highlights one of the flagged thumbnails. Beside the monitor on the desk: a compact dark magnifying glass with a golden rim, and a small stack of matte black prints. body.text: Valida paleta, identidad del personaje y safe zones antes de componer. El filtro que atrapa el drift antes de que llegue a publicación.

images.concept: Dark editorial product shot. Two smartphones placed side by side on a matte black desk surface, screens facing camera. Left phone shows a generic Instagram carousel post — muted, desaturated, warm-toned beige background with plain orange typography (no handle visible, post deliberately anonymous). Right phone shows a brief JSON document with gold syntax highlighting (#D4AF37 on keys) on a dark UI — clearly a reinterpreted version of the same content with editorial dark branding. Between the two phones, a subtle gold arrow drawn in light (like a light-painted chevron) points from left phone to right phone. Camera-left warm golden rim light at #D4AF37 catches both phone frames. Top 30% frame empty dark for text. No person. 35mm, shallow DOF, film grain. 4:5 aspect ratio.

body.text: Pásale un carrusel viral de tu nicho. El skill lo analiza y devuelve un brief reinterpretado con tu voz, tu paleta y tu personaje. Sin plagiar, sin bloqueo creativo.
